blockers.detail: Sidecar declares MIT, but the pinned source archive contains no licence/NOTICE texts; confirm scope and original copyright/attribution.

21 native package licences collected, but vendored C/C++ dependencies and the prebuilt runtime need a complete binary-to-source/NOTICE inventory (including libsodium, libuv, V8/ICU and libc++ where actually linked).
Bare Kit v2.5.5 root Apache licence is retained; the prebuild ZIP/AAR has no full native NOTICE inventory or verified build provenance.
The source Trackium repository has no explicit distribution licence at its pin. Owner-authorized prototype reuse does not establish a general third-party licence.
